title: MCP Toolset Pruner input
description: Provide MCP/agent tool definitions plus the tasks your agent must perform. The Actor returns a smaller candidate allowlist, uncovered intents, and confusion warnings. No LLM calls are used.

tools.title: Tool definitions
tools.description: MCP-style tool definitions. Each item should include name, description, and optionally inputSchema.

default.name: search_web
default.description: Search the public web for current information.

default.name: delete_document
default.description: Delete a document by ID after explicit approval.

default.name: find_documents
default.description: Find internal documents matching a query.

toolsJson.title: Tools JSON (alternative)
toolsJson.description: Optional raw JSON string containing a single tool, array of tools, or tools/list response. Used only when tools is empty.

taskIntents.title: Task intents
taskIntents.description: Short descriptions of tasks the agent must still be able to perform, e.g. 'search internal documentation' or 'find current web information'.

maxTools.title: Maximum selected tools
maxTools.description: Maximum candidate allowlist size. Coverage warnings remain visible when the cap is too small.

minIntentScore.title: Minimum intent evidence score
minIntentScore.description: Minimum lexical/schema evidence required to say an intent has a matching tool. Higher is stricter.

confusionThreshold.title: Tool confusion threshold
confusionThreshold.description: Jaccard similarity threshold for flagging tool pairs with overlapping routing signals.
